what_this_lane_repairs.defect: Two production picks four days apart — different sports, different events, different selections — carried the identical metadata.marketProbability 0.478261 and both claimed realEdgeSource 'sgo'. The September NFL moneyline was priced off a 75-day-old June MLB offer.
two_independent_causes: findLatestByMarketKey(key, provider?, participant?) read an omitted argument as 'no filter' rather than 'no match'. Sport and event were never predicates at all.
Nothing bounded how old an offer could be. With ingestion parked since 2026-06-30, the June MLB rows are the only rows a market key can reach, so the wrong answer was also the only available one.
what_this_lane_repairs.blast_radius_beyond_display: metadata.kellySizing.recommended_units of 40 and 50 were computed off the borrowed probability, and metadata.contrarySignal reported strongly-contrarian divergence from a market that was never read.

Promotion scoring against the repaired edge, including that an unavailable edge scores the 0.35-weighted component at zero rather than off another sport.
The submission path, including that participant scope is taken from classifyMarketFamilyForGrading rather than a private string heuristic.

Golden fixtures. nba-trader-insights-win moves qualified/exclusive-insights/94.86 -> suppressed/59.04; that is the repair working, its edge had been market-backed only by an offer that did not match its scope.

stated_limit.finding: sport_key is NOT part of the provider_offer_current identity key
stated_limit.evidence: buildProviderOfferCurrentIdentityKey (packages/db/src/runtime-repositories.ts:10003-10017) joins providerKey, providerEventId, providerMarketKey, providerParticipantId and bookmakerKey. sport_key is absent. provider_offer_current is upserted onConflict 'identity_key'.
stated_limit.observed: The NFL wrong-sport near-miss is present in provider_offer_history and absent from provider_offer_current: it shares an identity_key with the NBA exact-scope row, which was written later and overwrote it. This is why current holds 7 rows where history holds 9.
stated_limit.what_is_still_proven: Test 1 seeds only the near-misses and runs BEFORE any exact-scope row exists, so at that moment the NFL row is the live current row and the NBA-scoped lookup refuses it. The sport predicate is therefore demonstrated to discriminate in SQL.
stated_limit.what_is_NOT_proven: That a sport_key stored on a provider_offer_current row is durable. Two offers differing only in sport collapse to one row and the last write wins.
stated_limit.risk_direction: Fail-closed, not fail-open. An overwritten sport_key can only make a scoped lookup REFUSE an offer it should have matched (edge recorded unavailable, which this lane already handles without manufacturing a value). It cannot manufacture a match unless the provider emits one event id under two sports, which would itself be a provider data defect.
stated_limit.disposition: Recorded, not repaired here. Adding sport_key to the identity key changes the write path's collision semantics for every offer in production and is out of this lane's file scope and its stated purpose.
